evidence.field: file description, image source, and reuse terms
evidence.text: The file page describes 花-seal.svg as a digitally created vector depicting 花 in Shuowen seal-script style. It links the drawing to S04460 on the 華 entry at Chinese Etymology and states that the SVG representation is public domain. The original-file link resolved to an upload.wikimedia.org URL but the web tool could not fetch it (cache miss); I therefore verified the file page and link target, not the image pixels.
evidence.title: File:花-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The Commons search returned unrelated character files and did not establish a bronze-form image for 𠌶 or 華. The linked Western Zhou bronze category also did not establish such a character-specific candidate.
evidence.title: Category:Western Zhou bronze script characters - Wikimedia Commons

search_audit.query: site:commons.wikimedia.org 𠌶 bronze character glyph Wikimedia Commons
search_audit.outcome: Searched Commons. Results did not provide an identified 𠌶 or 華 bronze glyph image. Opened the Western Zhou bronze category; its listed files did not identify the target forms.

search_audit.query: 花-seal.svg Wikimedia Commons file 花 seal script
search_audit.outcome: Opened the Commons description page and verified its seal-style description, source association, digital creation, and public-domain representation terms. Followed its original-file link; fetching the direct image failed with a cache miss, so pixels were not inspected.

gaps: No Xiaoxuetang candidate was available: the supplied official query returned HTTP 401. The Commons search did not establish a usable early 𠌶/華 image with character identity and reuse provenance.

The only selected candidate is a modern vector redraw in Shuowen seal-script style, not an ancient artifact photograph. It illustrates a seal-style rendering of 花 and does not document the graph’s earliest historical formation. The direct image fetch failed, so visual content was not independently inspected.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script style; modern digital drawing uploaded 2017
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 花 in a Shuowen seal-script style; a later graphic form, not an artifact image.
items.alt: A digitally redrawn seal-style form of 花.
items.selection_reason: The Commons file page identifies the character, style, source association, and public-domain terms. This is a usable provenance-backed example of a later seal-style representation, though it cannot show the early 𠌶/華 forms.
items.rights: The file page places the SVG representation in the public domain.

limitations.text: The direct image link returned a cache-miss access error in the web tool. The candidate is retained based on the inspected Commons description and exact linked URL; its pixels were not inspected.
No character-specific reusable image of an early 𠌶 or 華 form was established in this search.
